quiz.question_id: errors.Is() memeriksa error di mana dalam rantai wrapping?
quiz.question_en: Where in the wrapping chain does errors.Is() check for an error?
options_en: Throughout the entire chain (including wrapped errors)

quiz.question_id: Apa yang harus dioper sebagai argumen kedua ke errors.As()?
quiz.question_en: What must be passed as the second argument to errors.As()?
options_en: A pointer to the target error type

quiz.question_id: Kapan sebaiknya menggunakan errors.As daripada errors.Is?
quiz.question_en: When should you use errors.As instead of errors.Is?
options_id: Ketika Anda perlu mengakses field dari custom error type
Ketika Anda ingin membandingkan dua pesan error
options_en: When you need to access fields from a custom error type
When you want to compare two error messages
